**1:** Both sections define the same three layers with the same bold-lead structure; the accompanying diagram splits short-term memory into two nodes ('Working State' and 'Context Window'), but the prose itself stays three-way, the same milder version of the layer-splitting pattern seen in other articles in this set that does not affect core_content. The synaptic-tagging/LTP neuroscience addition (verified below) is an enhancement, not an omission.

Real-World Lessons: Challenges and Best Practices:

The generated section adds two full extra subsections ('Trustworthy Memory and Privacy' and, as elsewhere in this set, 'The Human Factor'), plus the three depth additions verified below — all enrichments, none of which cause an expected idea to go missing.

Conclusion:
**0:** Both sections make the same 'memory transforms a stateless system into a personalized agent' point and the same 'temporary workaround for continual learning' point.
